dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent elliptical and interlocking 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, light-colored perimeters. The edges exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark fur exterior to a high-intensity light interior, particularly visible in the central-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity (dark) asymmetrical clusters of solid pixels localized within the centers of the light-colored rings. These spots lack internal gradients and are most concentrated along the lateral midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest light-colored annuli in the central flank form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary linear arrangement of dark blobs is visible extending towards the posterior flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique honeycomb-like interlocking configuration of annular rings where boundaries are shared between adjacent 'O' shapes in the mid-section.
